description: This module allows you to get Keycloak realm public information using the Keycloak REST API.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production). Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Get a Keycloak public key
  community.general.keycloak_realm_info:
    realm: MyCustomRealm
    auth_keycloak_url: https://auth.example.com/auth
  delegate_to: localhost

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Message as to what action was taken. Returned: always

return_values.name: realm_info
return_values.description: Representation of the realm public information. Returned: always

return_values.name: account-service
return_values.description: Account console URL. Returned: always Sample: "https://auth.example.com/auth/realms/MyRealm/account"

return_values.name: public_key
return_values.description: Public key of the realm. Returned: always Sample: "MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAO..."

return_values.name: token-service
return_values.description: Token endpoint URL. Returned: always Sample: "https://auth.example.com/auth/realms/MyRealm/protocol/openid-connect"

return_values.name: tokens-not-before
return_values.description: The token not before. Returned: always Sample: 0
